slug: 2024-09-17 Rwanda conducts pilot to implement biometric SIM registration, verification

facts.fact: A pilot of biometric SIM registration was launched under the new RURA regulations, which require operators to verify customers' fingerprints and face against NIDA data and to link each SIM to the owner's unique identification number.
